subject: R2 battery not holding a full shift

comments.author: carla.nunez@waynesupply.com
comments.body: Two of our R2 units are dying around hour 6 of an 8-hour shift. They used to last the full shift.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: Both packs show over 900 charge cycles, so they are due for replacement. We're shipping two new packs under your lease at no charge.

subject: Refund request for unused R2 accessory kit

comments.author: ben.ostrowski@acmefoods.com
comments.body: We ordered a spare gripper kit 10 days ago and no longer need it. Can we return it for a refund?

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: Yes. Our refund policy allows returns within 14 days of delivery, so you're inside the window. I've sent a ShipFast return label.

subject: R2 unit arrived with cracked sensor housing

comments.author: ian.kowalski@umbrellafreight.com
comments.body: One of the three units delivered today has a cracked lidar housing. The crate was visibly crushed on one corner.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: Sorry about that. I've opened a damage claim with ShipFast Logistics and a replacement unit ships Monday; ShipFast will collect the damaged one.

subject: Can't log in to Cloud Console after password reset

comments.author: pat.lin@hooliretail.com
comments.body: I reset my Cloud Console password and now get 'account locked' on every attempt.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: Too many attempts with the old password triggered a lockout. I've cleared it; please log in with the new password.

subject: Question about extending our R2 lease

comments.author: nora.feld@soylentgrocers.com
comments.body: If we add 4 more robots on lease, do they co-term with our existing 10?

comments.author: priya@northwind.dev
comments.body: Yes, added units co-term at $1,450/month each, prorated for the first partial month. I've looped in your CSM Omar to send a quote.

subject: July invoice overcharged by roughly $9k

comments.author: helen.marsh@starkdistribution.com
comments.body: Our July invoice bills all 64 robots for a full month, but 8 were added on July 18. We were overcharged for those units.

comments.author: priya@northwind.dev
comments.body: Escalating to Mei Chen, our billing service owner. Looks like a proration issue.

comments.author: mei@northwind.dev
comments.body: Confirmed a proration bug in the billing service for mid-cycle additions (BIL-31), now fixed. A corrected invoice and credit memo have been issued.

subject: Charging dock shows amber light, robot won't charge

comments.author: raymond.cho@initech.com
comments.body: Dock 3 shows a steady amber light and the R2 docked there isn't charging.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: Amber means the contact plates are dirty or misaligned. Clean them with isopropyl and re-seat the dock; send a photo if it persists.

subject: R2 drops Wi-Fi every few hours after firmware 2.8

comments.author: pat.lin@hooliretail.com
comments.body: Since updating to firmware 2.8 last week, robots lose Wi-Fi every few hours and stop mid-pick until rebooted.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: Try disabling band steering on your APs so robots stay on 5 GHz. Engineering is tracking this as FW-77.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: No KB article for this yet; workaround is ad hoc.

subject: Robots disconnecting when moving between aisles

comments.author: ben.ostrowski@acmefoods.com
comments.body: Our R2s go offline whenever they cross from aisle 4 to aisle 5. Started after the 2.8 update.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: This is a known roaming issue in 2.8 (FW-77). As a workaround, pin those robots to the AP covering aisles 4-6 while we work on a hotfix.

subject: PayStream invoice PDF missing line items

comments.author: carla.nunez@waynesupply.com
comments.body: Our new invoice PDF from PayStream only shows a total, no per-robot lines. Our AP team needs the breakdown.

comments.author: mei@northwind.dev
comments.body: This comes from the PayStream migration template; tracking the fix in BIL-40. I've attached an itemized export from our billing service in the meantime.

subject: Fleet losing network connectivity intermittently

comments.author: ian.kowalski@umbrellafreight.com
comments.body: Several robots show 'offline' in Atlas for 1-2 minutes at a time, a few times per shift. Running firmware 2.8.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: Same pattern as FW-77. Disabling band steering has helped other sites; a 2.8.1 hotfix is in progress.

subject: R2 Wi-Fi roaming failures since update

comments.author: derek.holm@waynesupply.com
comments.body: After 2.8, robots fail to roam between APs and sit idle until someone power-cycles them.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: Known 2.8 issue (FW-77). Please pin each robot's zone to a single AP for now; I'll update you when 2.8.1 ships.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: Fourth Wi-Fi ticket this month and still no FAQ/KB entry to link. Writing the workaround by hand each time.

subject: Refund request for 2 R2 units

comments.author: raymond.cho@initech.com
comments.body: We bought 2 extra R2 units 22 days ago for a project that got cancelled. Can we return them for a refund?

comments.author: priya@northwind.dev
comments.body: Yes. Our refund window is 30 days from delivery, so both units qualify. ShipFast will pick them up and the refund posts once they're inspected.

subject: Proration looks wrong for 8 robots added mid-cycle

comments.author: pat.lin@hooliretail.com
comments.body: We added 8 robots on Aug 20. The September invoice charge for them doesn't match our math.

comments.author: mei@northwind.dev
comments.body: I checked the billing service: the August charge covered Aug 20-31 (12 of 31 days) and September is a full month. Breakdown attached; no correction needed.

subject: How long do we have to return a robot?

comments.author: nora.feld@soylentgrocers.com
comments.body: Before we buy two more units, what's your refund window if they don't work out?

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: You can request a full refund within 30 days of delivery.

subject: Robots keep disconnecting from Wi-Fi (firmware 2.8)

comments.author: lydia.pratt@initech.com
comments.body: We see random Wi-Fi disconnects on about a third of our fleet since the 2.8 rollout.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: This is FW-77. Turn off band steering on your controller as a workaround; there's no KB article yet, sorry for the manual steps.

subject: Atlas beta feedback: scheduling view and alerts

comments.author: ian.kowalski@umbrellafreight.com
comments.body: Atlas beta is working well overall. The scheduling view is slow with 30 robots and offline alerts fire too often.

comments.author: priya@northwind.dev
comments.body: Thanks, Ian. I've passed this to the Atlas product team; it's tracked in ATL-204.

subject: SSO required for Atlas rollout

comments.author: dana.whitfield@globexlogistics.com
comments.body: Our security policy requires SAML SSO. We cannot roll Atlas out to our 120 robots until Enterprise SSO via KeyGate works.

comments.author: priya@northwind.dev
comments.body: Escalated to Devon Lee (Identity). Tied to ATL-212; Omar is handling the account side.

comments.author: devon@northwind.dev
comments.body: ATL-212 is still blocked on KeyGate's SAML metadata signing-cert rotation bug. KeyGate now says Oct 13 at the earliest; we'll confirm as soon as it lands.

subject: R2 stuck 'reconnecting' several times a day

comments.author: marcus.webb@soylentgrocers.com
comments.body: Our robots show 'reconnecting' on screen several times a day since the August update to 2.8.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: Known roaming bug in 2.8 (FW-77). Pinning each robot to its nearest AP should stabilize it until the 2.8.1 hotfix.

subject: ShipFast return pickup never arrived

comments.author: raymond.cho@initech.com
comments.body: ShipFast was supposed to collect the 2 returned units yesterday but no one showed up.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: ShipFast missed the window; pickup is rebooked for Oct 3 between 9am and noon. Your refund timing isn't affected.

subject: Lease buyout options at end of term

comments.author: derek.holm@waynesupply.com
comments.body: Can we buy out our leased R2s at the end of the term, and what would that cost?

comments.author: priya@northwind.dev
comments.body: Buyouts are available at end of term; pricing depends on unit age. I've asked Omar to send you a quote.

subject: Your policy page says 14 days but your agent said 30

comments.author: ben.ostrowski@acmefoods.com
comments.body: Your policy page says 14 days but your agent said 30. We're at day 20 on a returned unit; which one applies?

comments.author: priya@northwind.dev
comments.body: Apologies for the confusion: the current window is 30 days, so your return qualifies. The policy page is out of date and we're correcting it.

comments.author: priya@northwind.dev
comments.body: Reminder to self: refund policy doc still says 14 days; update is overdue.

subject: Wi-Fi drops on R2 fleet after 2.8 upgrade

comments.author: helen.marsh@starkdistribution.com
comments.body: We upgraded our 64 robots to 2.8 last week and now see Wi-Fi drops during handoff between APs.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: Same issue as FW-77. Disable band steering and pin high-traffic zones to one AP; the 2.8.1 hotfix is in progress. We still don't have a KB article, so I'm sending the steps directly.

subject: Cloud Console 2FA reset for new site manager

comments.author: tom.reyes@globexlogistics.com
comments.body: Our new site manager inherited a Cloud Console account but the 2FA device belonged to her predecessor.

comments.author: marco@northwind.dev
comments.body: After verifying with your admin, I've reset 2FA on that account. She'll be prompted to enroll a new device at next login.
